competing_hypotheses.statement: Local spectral and sensitivity features of the early window contain holdout-predictive information about long-transient onset beyond baseline activity/entropy/size features (Y19-H1).
All predictable signal is already in simple features; adding spectral/sensitivity features does not improve sealed-holdout Brier by MCID.
Any apparent candidate gain is spurious size/K confounding; after ablating N/K from the candidate, holdout MCID fails.

null_results.interpretation: candidate failed sealed-holdout MCID vs baseline
